tuicopy.slash.copy: Send the latest answer (or the nth latest) to the terminal clipboard
tuicopy.sent: Sent answer {n} ({count} characters) to the terminal clipboard. If nothing pastes, your terminal blocks clipboard requests (OSC 52).
tuicopy.none: There is no answer to copy yet.
tuicopy.range: There are only {max} answer(s) to copy; use /copy with a number from 1 to {max}.
tuicopy.usage: Usage: /copy [n] (1 is the latest answer, 2 the one before it)
tuicopy.tooLarge: Answer {n} is {bytes} bytes; one clipboard request carries at most {max} bytes. Select the text with the mouse instead.
tuicopy.unavailable: This terminal cannot take a clipboard request here (it is not an interactive terminal).
